threads.body: [Config] This breaking change also removes the published declarative keys `java.grpc.capture_metadata.client.request` and `java.grpc.capture_metadata.server.request`, but the migration note only covers flat properties. Declarative YAML users therefore have no documented replacement path; list the corresponding `java.grpc.{client,server}.request_metadata.included` keys here as well.
threads.hunk:
@@ -4,6 +4,10 @@
 
 ### ⚠️ Breaking changes
 
+- Remove `otel.instrumentation.grpc.capture-metadata.client.request` and
+  `otel.instrumentation.grpc.capture-metadata.server.request`.
+  Use `otel.instrumentation.grpc.client.request-metadata.included` and
+  `otel.instrumentation.grpc.server.request-metadata.included`.

replies.body:
Addressed in e5f345635f7f0e2fb805a83bd665bc94aa2459fc.

Analysis: Valid: docs/instrumentation-list.yaml at the frozen SHA still lists the old declarative names, and the changelog only covered flat properties.

Upsides: Complete migration guidance for declarative users.

Downsides: None significant.
